explanation: A Samaritan leader who opposed Nehemiah's work in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem.
An Ammonite nobleman and enemy of Nehemiah, who also tried to hinder the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.
An Arab ruler who was allied with Sanballat and Tobiah in their attempt to oppose Nehemiah's project.
A revelation or message from God delivered through a prophet. In the book of Nehemiah, false prophets try to deceive Nehemiah.
The physical barrier around Jerusalem that Nehemiah and his people worked to rebuild in order to protect the city and its inhabitants.
Written communication between individuals. In Nehemiah chapter 6, letters are used as a tool to spread lies and rumors about Nehemiah and his work.
A feeling of anxiety or worry caused by a threat. Nehemiah's opponents tried to create fear among the people to stop the rebuilding of the wall.
